title: MCP Gateway Layer 3 - EDR Process Spawn Event
description: Telemetry event emitted when Layer 3 (Process-Spawn Evaluation) detects or blocks a process spawn attempt in tool-call arguments. Schema is compatible with CrowdStrike Falcon process tree and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint DeviceProcessEvents.

event_type.description: Whether the spawn was blocked or detected (shadow mode)

source.description: Fixed identifier for correlation in SIEM

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that made the tool call

request_id.description: Unique request ID for tracing through the full 5-layer pipeline

arguments_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full argument payload (for matching without exposing content)

process_details.description: Maps to CrowdStrike Falcon ProcessRollup2 and Defender DeviceProcessEvents

command_line.description: Detected command that would be spawned. Maps to Falcon: CommandLine, Defender: ProcessCommandLine

target_executable.description: Resolved binary path. Maps to Falcon: ImageFileName, Defender: FileName

spawn_pattern.description: Classification of the detected spawn pattern

parent_process.description: The agent runtime is always the logical parent. Maps to Falcon: ParentBaseFileName

rule_id.description: The specific Layer 3 rule that triggered (e.g., PS-001, PS-004)

current.description: SHA-256 of this entry including previous hash
